sources_quoted.quote: Enemy champions within {{tt|700 units|center to edge}} of you become cursed, causing them to receive {{as|12% increased magic damage|magic damage}} from all sources.
rules_extracted: applies to MAGIC damage only (not physical, not true)
applies to ENEMY champions only, within 700 units of the wearer
credited against damage from ALL sources (allies included), not just the wearer

sources_quoted.quote: {{tip|Immobilize|Immobilizing}} an enemy champion marks them as ''Vulnerable'' for 4 seconds, increasing the damage they take from all sources by 7%. Subsequent immobilizes against a target extend the duration of the effect.
rules_extracted: amplifier of 7% on ALL damage types (all sources)
gated on an immobilize, 4 s window, extended by later immobilizes
independent atomizer pass also binds Unmake's 12% to the magic-damage family and to a 700-unit radius

sources_quoted.source: docs/math-foundations.md, Section 2.1 and the Section 5 audit table
sources_quoted.quote: m(R) = 100 / (100 + R) ... post = raw · m(R) ... [Resistance mitigation] EXACT
rules_extracted: mitigation is LINEAR in raw damage, so a damage-taken amplifier commutes with mitigation: applying 1.12 pre- or post-mitigation is identical. Any discrepancy therefore cannot come from amp/mitigation ordering, only from WHICH damage the amp is applied to.

sources_quoted.quote: Shield absorption (survival walk) | clipping identity absorbed = min(shield, damage), overkill = max(0, damage−absorbed) | EXACT
rules_extracted: health_damage = total incoming − absorbed; with a fully-consumed shield the absorbed term is constant across the two runs, so the DELTA between runs equals the delta of total damage (222.5) even when a shield exists

observed.note: delta of health_damage equals delta of total incoming damage regardless of any fully-consumed shield (clipping identity above)

step_1_enumerate_wiki_sanctioned_amplifi: Abyssal 'Unmake': x1.12, MAGIC damage only, only if participant 2 is an ENEMY of the Abyssal wearer and inside 700 units; credited to damage from all sources
Imperial Mandate 'Command': x1.07, ALL damage types, only while Vulnerable (4 s from an immobilize)

step_2_falsify_candidate_explanations_of.hypothesis: H1: the 12% curse was dropped wholesale from participant 2's entire incoming damage
step_2_falsify_candidate_explanations_of.result: IMPOSSIBLE: 1854.17 < new health_damage 3047.1; health damage cannot exceed total damage

step_2_falsify_candidate_explanations_of.hypothesis: H2: Imperial Mandate's 7% all-sources amp was dropped wholesale (no shield)
step_2_falsify_candidate_explanations_of.test: then ratio old/new must be exactly 1.070000, i.e. new = 3269.6 / 1.07 = 3055.70
step_2_falsify_candidate_explanations_of.result: observed new is 3047.1, off by 8.6; observed ratio is 1.07302, not 1.07000
step_2_falsify_candidate_explanations_of.status: falsified in the no-shield case; only survivable if a shield absorbed exactly 131.5 in both runs, an unexplained free parameter (neither Abyssal Mask nor Imperial Mandate grants a shield)

step_2_falsify_candidate_explanations_of.hypothesis: H3: the 12% curse was NARROWED from 'all damage participant 2 takes' to 'magic damage only' (the wiki rule)
step_2_falsify_candidate_explanations_of.test: delta = 0.12 x (non-magic post-Mandate damage) -> non-magic = 222.5 / 0.12 = 1854.1667; remaining cursed magic (post-curse) = 3047.1 − 1854.1667 = 1192.9333 -> pre-curse magic = 1192.9333 / 1.12 = 1065.119
step_2_falsify_candidate_explanations_of.result: fully self-consistent, all components positive and plausible (magic share of the new total = 39.1%); reconstructing the old number: 1.12 x (1854.1667 + 1065.119) = 3269.60 exactly
step_2_falsify_candidate_explanations_of.status: CONSISTENT with the quoted wiki text

step_2_falsify_candidate_explanations_of.hypothesis: H4: the curse was narrowed to enemy champions only (participant 2 previously cursed while not a valid target), removing 12% from its magic damage
step_2_falsify_candidate_explanations_of.test: delta = 0.12 x (participant 2's magic damage) -> magic = 1854.17 of a 3047.1 total (60.9% magic share)
step_2_falsify_candidate_explanations_of.result: also self-consistent; same arithmetic signature, same direction (old over-applied Unmake)
step_2_falsify_candidate_explanations_of.status: CONSISTENT with the quoted wiki text

step_2_falsify_candidate_explanations_of.hypothesis: H5 (the only 'old was right' reading): the curse was wrongly narrowed from 'from all sources' to only the wearer's own magic damage, deleting allies' 1854.17 of cursed magic damage
step_2_falsify_candidate_explanations_of.result: cannot be excluded by arithmetic alone, but it would require a change that directly contradicts the explicit wiki phrase 'from all sources'; two of the three surviving readings (H3, H4) say the OLD value over-applied Unmake, and only this one says the new value under-applies it

step_3_conclusion.reasoning: The 222.5 drop is a 12%-shaped effect, not a 7%-shaped one: the observed whole-total ratio 1.07302 is provably NOT the 1.07000 that a wholesale removal of Imperial Mandate's all-sources Vulnerable amp would produce, and a wholesale removal of the 12% curse is arithmetically impossible (it would make the total smaller than the surviving health damage). What remains is a NARROWING of Abyssal Mask's Unmake from a broader application to the one the cached wiki text authorizes - 12% on MAGIC damage only, against ENEMY champions only. Under that reading the old number reconstructs exactly as 1.12 x (1854.17 non-magic + 1065.12 magic) = 3269.6, i.e. the old run amplified 1854.17 of damage that Unmake is not allowed to touch. The new value 3047.1 = 1854.17 + 1.12 x 1065.12 is the value the quoted text supports.
step_3_conclusion.wiki_upper_bound_check: Both amplifiers remain within their wiki magnitudes in the new value (magic portion carries at most x1.12 from Unmake and x1.07 from Command; non-magic carries at most x1.07). No wiki-sanctioned amplifier is missing from the new number that could account for a further 7.30% of the total.

independent_computation.confidence: high on direction (the old value applied Unmake's 12% to damage the wiki text excludes), medium on exactness
limitations: The scenario definition for 'mandate_abyssal_curse_roster' (champions, levels, builds, participant ordering, fight window) lives under scripts/ or tests/, which runbook R-18/R-19 forbids this investigator from reading. A full end-to-end re-simulation of participant 2's damage was therefore not possible from data/ + docs/math-foundations.md alone.

What was verified independently is the amplifier identity implied by the delta: which wiki-sanctioned amplifier can and cannot produce a 222.5 / 7.30% drop on this leaf, and which reading of the cached Abyssal Mask and Imperial Mandate text each candidate corresponds to.

The one reading under which the old value would be correct (H5: Unmake narrowed to the wearer's own damage) contradicts the explicit 'from all sources' phrase in the cached wiki text and is judged unsupported, but it is not excluded by arithmetic.
